raw.text:
🚨 DOCTORS JUST LOWERED “NORMAL” BLOOD PRESSURE AGAIN — AND PEOPLE ARE STARTING TO QUESTION EVERYTHING

In the 1970s, 160/95 was considered acceptable.  
Then it became 140/90.  
Now they’re pushing optimal all the way down to 110/70.  

Did our bodies suddenly change… or did the definition just keep moving?  

A growing number of voices are saying high blood pressure is often not the real disease. 

It’s the body’s compensation for deeper problems like insulin resistance, chronic inflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. 

Some studies even show that pushing numbers too low can increase the risk of heart attacks, kidney decline, and dementia... especially in older people.  

Most doctors are still only treating the number on the screen. Almost none are measuring the actual root causes.  

Are they actually helping people… or are they just creating more lifelong patients?

raw.author: CMEINDIA1
raw.text:
The Glucose Management Indicator (GMI) is a metric derived from Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) data that estimates a person’s laboratory-measured HbA1c. While GMI estimates A1C based on average glucose levels from 14+ days of sensor data, it is not identical to laboratory A1C, which measures blood sugar attached to red blood cells over 120 days. 

Key GMI & CGM Insights:

Purpose: GMI replaced "estimated A1C" (eA1C) to indicate current glucose control based on CGM data, rather than predicting the exact lab-tested result

GMI vs. A1C

 A lower GMI than lab A1C means the average CGM glucose is higher than predicted; a higher GMI than lab A1C suggests the average CGM glucose is lower than predicted.

Key Differences: 

GMI is based on daily glucose averages, whereas HbA1c is influenced by red blood cell lifespan.

Accuracy: 

While useful, GMI can differ from A1C due to rapid fluctuations, averaging 0.12–0.14 percentage points difference, though it can vary.

Usage: 
GMI is found on all standard CGM summary reports to guide diabetes management. 

GMI is generally considered more useful for evaluating recent glycemic trends (over 2 weeks) than laboratory HbA1c, which looks back over 3 months.

CGM may have an important role in type 2 diabetes even for people who are not using insulin.
@NEJM 

In this 26-week primary care RCT of 283 adults:
📉 HbA1c: 7.2% with CGM vs 8.0% with routine care

⏱️ Time in range: +21 percentage points

✅ No severe hypoglycaemia reported

For patients: seeing glucose responses in real time may help connect food, activity and treatment with glucose levels.

Need robust data on cost-effectiveness and in which patient population with T2 diabetes

@AskDrShashank

raw.author: BoboLucyWisdom
raw.text:
跟许多人想象的不同，生酮不需要很长时间，5到10天的生酮就可以缓解很多症状。就我个人来说，20天的生酮就逆转了我长期的炎症体制。

生酮饮食原本是用来治疗癫痫的，但科学家发现它可以治愈糖尿病、老年痴呆症、精神分裂症、抑郁、自闭症等等

酮体是一种清洁燃料，当你的大脑从燃烧葡萄糖切换到冉手酮，大脑的修复系统就被激活了。

很多人认为生酮饮食就是不吃碳水多吃肉。但实际上生酮的关键在于足够的脂肪，饮食比例中要达到65%-75%的脂肪。比如橄榄油、鳄梨油、坚果油、猪油、黄油等等。

糖和淀粉是目前饮食的大问题。高碳水饮食导致葡萄糖过量，导致胰岛素抵抗，导致一系列的代谢问题。本质上就是你的身体失去了自我调节的能力，所以血糖剧烈波动。

当你生酮时，身体就可以修复新陈代谢功能的障碍，提高胰岛素敏感性。

长期饮食不需要那么极端，你可以保持低碳，但不需要完全生酮。事实上只要你从胰岛素抵抗中恢复过来，你就会发现低碳和轻断食是一个自然而然的选择，因为你根本不容易饥饿，更不会低血糖，你对食物的欲望也没有那么强烈了。

但如果你有2型糖尿病或者其他严重疾病，作为治疗，你需要坚持严格生酮几个月，等到代谢机能恢复。

想了解更多生酮和低碳饮食的信息，关注我的账号。
